artifacts.purpose: evaluator checkpoint; never a CBSC generator checkpoint

auroc.interpretation: High AUROC proves separability; low AUROC means only that this evaluator failed to separate the samples at this representation and sample size.

four_momentum.adapter_note: Both Geant4 and Fast-MC deposits use the same frozen 6,790-channel readout adapter; the Geant4 result is the domain/reference control for interpreting Fast-MC accuracy.
